subject: ddl: Fix tiflash replica available status after native br (#63293)
summary: Adds a v2 DDL job arg (`ResetAvailable`) and uses it when repairing missing TiFlash placement rules (native BR restore path) to force `TiFlashReplica.Available` back to false so users/optimizer won’t treat TiFlash as ready prematurely; also extends TiFlash progress calculation to return both full-replica and at-least-one-replica progress and updates DDL polling/cache/logging plus a failpoint name fix.
